content.text: {"summary":"Miami-Dade County Hall moved down to level 4, Warning / Watch / Evacuation, from level 5, Hurricane Warning. For Irma, advisory 48 replaced advisory 47A, and the Hurricane Warning code for the location changed to a Tropical Storm Warning [S1]. The Tropical Storm Warning now sets the level [S1]. Follow the instructions of your local officials.","sources":["S1"]}
